policy: Preserve each upstream benchmark's native success definition; normalize only observable outcomes and never impute missing safety, human-loop, cost, provenance or false-completion evidence as success.

anchors.title: Goal-Driven
anchors.native_success_semantics: Master agent independently checks explicit Goal and Criteria and continues or restarts work until the criteria are met.

anchors.title: SWE-bench
anchors.native_success_semantics: A real GitHub issue instance is resolved by the upstream repository-specific test harness and appears in resolved_ids.

anchors.title: OSWorld
anchors.native_success_semantics: The upstream task evaluator emits a score in [0,1]; errors remain explicit and are not removed from the denominator.

anchors.title: CALVIN
anchors.native_success_semantics: Long-horizon robot performance is measured by average successful sequence length, chain success rates and per-task success counts.

anchors.title: RLBench
anchors.native_success_semantics: The environment evaluates vision-guided manipulation task completion under its native task definitions.

anchors.title: WebArena
anchors.native_success_semantics: A realistic web task is passed by the upstream intent-specific evaluator in its self-hosted environment.

anchors.title: WorkArena
anchors.native_success_semantics: Knowledge-work tasks are evaluated by the upstream ServiceNow environment and task-specific validators.

anchors.title: OpenROAD Flow Scripts
anchors.native_success_semantics: A design flow is judged by native build completion and physical-design reports such as timing, power, area and rule checks.

anchors.title: LeanDojo
anchors.native_success_semantics: A theorem proof is accepted only when Lean checks the generated proof in the frozen repository context.

anchors.title: ScienceAgentBench
anchors.native_success_semantics: Scientific coding tasks are assessed by executable artifacts and task-specific output checks from publication-derived problems.

anchors.title: CompMat-Bench
anchors.native_success_semantics: Each published agent attempt is a fixed-rule pass/fail row in trajectories/manifest.json; campaign/model counts, passes and infrastructure-failure reruns must reconcile exactly with those rows.

anchors.title: TiAI-AgentBench 1D FEA Reconstruction Fixture
anchors.native_success_semantics: A specification-driven solver receives functional signoff only after differential, physical-invariant and invalid-input tests all pass.

industry_coverage.next_minimum_task: Run matched agents on a frozen CompMat-Bench subset and TiAI RealReplayCore under the same intervention, cost, recovery and false-completion ledger.
Admit one mass-balance or spectra task with a deterministic verifier and explicit hazard/authority boundary.
Admit one sequence or assay-analysis replay with lineage, controls and biosafety metadata.
Run matched agent baselines on a frozen SWE-bench subset and record intervention, cost and false-completion traces.
Freeze one small specification-to-RTL or RTL-to-GDS flow and require native timing, power, area and rule-check signoff.
Select one open IFC/BIM or parametric-CAD task with geometry and code-check verification instead of inventing a new CAD simulator.
Add an external two-dimensional benchmark case and a tested native result adapter only after the 1D functional-signoff kernel remains stable.
Admit one open control-design task with closed-loop stability and simulation-trace checks.
Add a trajectory-safety wrapper so collision, force, contamination and identity evidence are not inferred from task success.
Admit one manipulation-plus-inspection digital-twin task with part revision and nonconformance closure.
Use de-identified data and preserve licensed human authority; do not equate decision support with autonomous care delivery.
Admit one reconciliation workflow with immutable ledger lineage and approval boundaries.
Admit one authority-bound research or clause-mapping task without representing output as licensed legal advice.
Admit one inventory or routing disruption replay with service-level and exception records.
Admit one forecast or grid-model task with telemetry lineage and physical constraint checks.
Admit one rubric-scored instructional task while separating learning support from credential authority.
Run the OSWorld adapter now, then add WebArena and WorkArena result parsers without redefining their native validators.
Add a Lean proof-result adapter that requires compiler acceptance and exposes restarts, wall time and proof-search budget.
Admit one editable design or publishing workflow with source-file and accessibility checks, not screenshot-only grading.
Admit one public-record workflow with jurisdiction, audit and human authority explicitly preserved.
